isolation: fresh chain per scenario: S1, the four S2 variants, S3 and the gas step each deploy and set up their own in-process Ganache, run side by side; nothing is shared

chain.engine: ganache 7.9.2 in-process provider, no RPC server
chain.timeTravel: evm_mine with a timestamp; no real-time waiting

definitions.resignatures: PASS votes accepted in the rounds that made every live release VERIFIED again after the key event
definitions.blockedSeconds: chain seconds (block timestamps) during which at least one live release was not VERIFIED; each transaction is its own block 1 s after the previous one, so this is a lower bound
definitions.servedVersions: validator-set versions under which the live releases were VERIFIED again; versions passed without a re-approval are not served and cost no signatures
definitions.gatewayPinChangesPerCompany: MCPSHIELD_VALIDATOR_SET_VERSION changes each company's Gateway needs, one per served version (apps/gateway/src/signed-admission.mjs:88)
definitions.gas.scheduleRotationFirst: a registry's first scheduleRotation, which fills its three empty pending slots; every chain here is fresh, so each scenario's scheduleRotation is a first one
definitions.gas.scheduleRotationAfterRotation: a later scheduleRotation on the same registry (gas step: after one rotate(), one key changed); rotate() leaves the pending slots filled
definitions.gas.disableBySlot: disable() compares validators[0], [1], [2] in order until it finds the key, so its gas grows with the key's slot
definitions.gas.dailyRenewal: gas step, second of two renewals: a new 1-day round on a release that is already VERIFIED, under the same set version, after A, B and C have all voted on this chain; the validator app caps every round at 24 h (apps/validator/src/v3.ts:21), so keeping a release VERIFIED takes one such round a day. The first PASS opens the round, the second decides it, the third is relayed after the decision
definitions.gas.firstRenewalAfterDecision: the third vote of the first renewal, C's first vote on this chain: it also writes C's nonce for the first time

setup.steps: publish one policy, register every live release, A PASS then B PASS on each

S1.title: normal rotation C -> C'
checks: rotationAt is the scheduleRotation block + 1 day
86400 s before rotationAt: set version 1 and every live release VERIFIED
rotate() 60 s before rotationAt reverts TIMELOCK
60 s before rotationAt: set version 1 and every live release VERIFIED
1 s before rotationAt: set version 1 and every live release VERIFIED
the outsider's rotate() lands at exactly rotationAt
rotate() raises the set version to 2 and installs A, B, C'
right after rotate() every live release reads EXPIRED
A's vote signed for set version 1 before the rotation is rejected STALE_VALIDATOR_SET
C's vote for set version 2 is rejected NOT_VALIDATOR
after-rotation: A + C' PASS make every live release VERIFIED under set version 2

S2.title: leaked key C: disable(C) at once, rotation to C' after the timelock

caughtBeforeUse.assumption: the leak is caught before C is used

withInterimReapproval.title: leaked key C caught before C is used; A + B re-approve at once
checks: disable(C) raises the set version to 2 at once
right after disable(C) every live release reads EXPIRED
C's vote is rejected NOT_VALIDATOR
C's quarantine is rejected NOT_VALIDATOR
A PASS + B ABSTAIN under set version 2: the round stays OPEN
A PASS + B ABSTAIN: the release stays EXPIRED
B cannot vote again in that round (DUPLICATE_VOTE)
a new round with A PASS + B PASS verifies it
the probe is rolled back
after the rollback the release reads EXPIRED again
interim-reapproval: A + B PASS make every live release VERIFIED under set version 2
rotationAt is the scheduleRotation block + 1 day
86400 s before rotationAt: set version 2 and every live release VERIFIED by the interim re-approval

right after rotate() every live release reads EXPIRED
after-rotation: A + C' PASS make every live release VERIFIED under set version 3
